Text: Your expedition teams located a derelict ship, drifting in the void between stars

It missed an orbital slingshot due to a computer glitch, and drifted for centuries.

Cryogenic pods fill the cargo bay: ruined, each bearing a corpse. One is undamaged, its occupant in frozen sleep. Through the glass you see her uniform, bearing the mark of the pre-Collapse Interstellar Authority and the medals of a superior officer.
Keep the pod powered; display her in my throne room

She blinks, slowly. The frozen statue thaws.

“What happened?” she rasps.

It will be a long story.
She was an Interstellar Authority officer before the Collapse

“I can’t recall details. But my emotional memories - people I loved, causes I worshipped - they’re like fresh wounds.

“We kept the corporations in line out here: Nova, Orion, all the others. We had to be judge, jury and executioner, but I always lived by my code.

“Where are those laws now? The best I can do is enforce... honour-codes? Feudal vendettas?”

“Throwing knife,” she explains. “He was aiming to kill. Looks like my Interstellar Authority training’s good for something.”

“It’s madness!” she shrieks. “Your rules, your laws, they just keep everyone in chains!” 

She tears an archival drive from its housing and flings it across the room.

“Before the Collapse, I had something to fight for! Corrupt, flawed, but it was something!”

It’s been less than a year since her successful coup in {StarSystem}.

“I want to thank {PlayerHouse} for helping me find my feet. But I see now the Authority’s gone for good.” You realise her holo-image is wearing {StarSystem}’s baronial crown, and her Interstellar Authority uniform’s nowhere in sight.

“I come from a world of legalities, evidence and police proceedings. But as a baron, all I see are threats, posturing and calls for vengeance.

“I've realised I can’t change you people, or your world. All I can do is try to stay standing.”
